name: Knowledge
notes: Recall (the Brain) and plugin knowledge tabs; top-level features only

features.feature: Knowledge shows in the activity bar only with Recall on or a plugin's tab shown; otherwise `#brain` opens Calls; with Recall off only the plugins' tabs show and the first one opens
Settings → Knowledge → Use Recall turns the index on or off; its card shows what it holds, the last sync, Sync now, Keep it current, the embedding server, model, key and the page reader
Recall's Sources, Dictionary and People tabs browse what was indexed, by client or thread
Who may speak into Recall through mail and channels is decided per client (Trust, Ignore, Read anyway, Keep out)
Claude sessions get Recall as a read-only MCP server scoped to their AI profile
Plugins add tabs to Knowledge, each plugin's a group under its name after Recall's, with their icons, and a card in Settings → Knowledge under Recall's (an old single tab still works)
A plugin tab's address `#brain/<plugin>:<tab>/<rest>` opens it with its rest as written, from a link, back and forward or a reload; a link to its hidden tab opens the plugin's first shown tab
A plugin's tab is hidden while it says so, and shows its badge (a number or !); the activity bar's Knowledge badge sums them, ! when any is !
A plugin's header strip shows over its tabs; moving between its tabs keeps each tab's scroll, what was typed and the plugin's state (nothing unloads until the plugin does)
The tab row's search box runs the shown plugin tab's own search and is hidden where that tab has none; Recall is never searched from a plugin tab
Files dropped on the window while any of a plugin's Knowledge tabs is shown go to that plugin
The gear at the end of Knowledge's tab row opens Settings → Knowledge
